name: Hedgie Bloom
summary: A hand-drawn birthday card where a shy hedgehog hands you a tulip to put in a jar
about: An interactive birthday card drawn in wobbly ink and watercolour on a wooden desk. The cover swings open on a springy hinge, a shy hedgehog pops up and brings a tulip out from behind its back. Drag the flower into the glass jar and a bouquet grows, the hedgehog hops for joy, petals fall and the birthday wish writes itself across the page. Change the names and the line, then send it as a link.
how: Press the card or Open the card: it lifts, the cover swings open and the hedgehog says hi.
The hedgehog brings a tulip out from behind its back and holds it out.
Drag the tulip into the jar (it swings as you move it); drop it elsewhere and it springs back. Tapping it or pressing Take the tulip works too.
The bouquet grows, the hedgehog hops, petals fall and the wish writes itself; Close the card resets it.
